governance.attested_by: run157 measured DAM AS-scarcity overlay (day-ahead analogue of RTORDPA) 2026-06-25
governance.note: run157 = the run155a keeper recipe (run154-lineage: net-load West/Panhandle Waha delivered-gas step, Laredo zone fix, energy+reserve co-opt on the measured 60-Day DAM AS + storage up-AS reservation + load-resource RRS-UFR credit, measured RTORDPA reliability-deployment overlay, net-load-indexed ST_GAS reliability drag, coal PRB passthrough sigmoid, measured F923/Henry-Hub fuel prices, EIA-860 BTM CHP host steam; plus run155a's storage-AS-from-2024 scope and battery_dispatch_adder=10 for the 2024 monthly LMP shape) WITH ONE NEW MEASURED LEVER: a post-solve, additive Day-Ahead AS-scarcity price overlay (results.scarcity.ercot_dam_as_overlay_series, enabled by --ercot-dam-as-overlay). On hours where ERCOT's day-ahead market co-optimized energy and ancillary services INTO SCARCITY, the AS clearing price (MCPC) jumps from competitive single-digits to hundreds/thousands and that scarcity rent lifts the day-ahead ENERGY price (settled DAM SPP = energy LMP + binding reserve/AS price). The energy+reserve LP forms only the energy dual plus an endogenous ORDC reserve adder; in hours that are not physically reserve-thin in the model — the grounded May-2024 case (May 8/24/26, elevated load but ample headroom) — it cannot form this DAM co-optimization scarcity, so it under-prices those acute days (May 2024 model load-wtd ~$24 vs actual DA $44.8). The overlay adds the MEASURED binding AS MCPC (per-hour max of the cleared RegUp/RRS/ECRS/NonSpin MCPCs from the ERCOT 60-Day DAM Disclosure Gen Resource Data, built by scripts/build_ercot_dam_as_mcpc.py to data/raw/ercot/ercot_<year>_dam_as_mcpc_hourly.parquet) on the scarce hours — the published additive co-optimization identity, additive to (not a re-pricing of) the energy dual. It is admissible per CLAUDE.md #10: an exogenous ERCOT-published quantity, backcast-able on any year from the same forward driver (next year's published DAM AS MCPCs), responsive to changed conditions (a tighter/looser AS market reprices), NEVER fit to LMP. Three gates keep it inert outside genuine DAM AS scarcity and prevent double-counting: (1) a scarcity threshold ($150/MWh; competitive DAM AS clears single-to-low-double digits — measured 2024 product means RegUp $6.5/RRS $5.6/ECRS $12.6/NonSpin $10.0 — so >$150 is the AS scarcity demand curve, not competitive offers; the May lift is robust $18-23 across $75-200, so the threshold's only job is inertness in non-scarce hours, NOT a fitted magnitude); (2) the pre-RTC+B regime gate, identical to RTORDPA (RTC+B retired the adders 2025-12-05); (3) a from-year scope (2024+): the 2023 stress year's day-ahead AS scarcity is the SAME event the RTORDPA reliability-deployment overlay already carries (RTORDPA material in 2023, near-inert 2024/25), so applying both in 2023 double-counts one scarcity through two measured channels and over-fires 2023-H2 (Aug binding-MCPC scarce-hour mean ~$222 >> actual DA ~$147) — the same year-scoping logic as ercot_storage_as_reserve_from_year. The overlay is post-solve: dispatch, volumes and emissions are byte-identical to run155a (battery 2024 throughput 0.775 TWh, unchanged). Incidence: 2023 0 hours (scoped off), 2024 69 hours, 2025 6 hours. No unit pinned to its observed CEMS generation; no adder/haircut/sigmoid tuned to a price or volume residual.
governance.residuals_note: The overlay is the structural fix for the documented May-2024 DAM-AS-co-optimized under-price (the run156 flat-ECRS probe was REJECTED as the wrong lever — May is not reserve-thin in the model, so a flat reserve-requirement add overshot Aug and over-fired 2023). It moves May 2024 model load-wtd LMP $23.6 -> $46.7 (actual DA $44.8 / RT $37.7) through measured scarce hours, and in doing so cuts the 2024 monthly price-shape NRMSE from 0.430 (run154) to 0.206 (just over the 0.20 C3b band) — a structural shape improvement, not a level fit. Months held: Apr 2024 $26.4 (actual RT 24.4 / DA 23.1; +~$2.6 from 17 measured Apr scarce hours, an over-tick documented not tuned), Aug 2024 $34.7 (actual 36.0/35.8, <$40, +$4.8), Jan 2024 $46.1 (actual DA 43.8; the measured Jan winter-storm scarcity), 2023 unchanged from the keeper (Aug $147.2, NOT over-fired; DAM-AS scoped off), 2025 $34.8 (+$0.2, held). Fuelmix C1 (2023/2024 complete-vintage years) and system-volume C2 PASS; 2025 fossil classes SKIPPED per the PRELIM_923_FROM_YEAR vintage rule inherited from run154. CC_REGULAR 2025 +TWh, Permian/Ector 2024 cheap-hour magnet, and Laredo HR are inherited run154 residuals, unaffected by this post-solve price overlay and documented there.

exceptions.reason: C3a price-LEVEL (soft). Model 2024 load-wtd mean $29.23 vs actual $26.83 = +9.0%, just over the +/-8% band. This is the EXPECTED cost of correctly pricing the measured 2024 day-ahead AS scarcity: the new DAM-AS overlay (a structurally-correct, MEASURED co-optimization mechanism, governance note above) lifts the acute May and Jan-winter-storm hours toward their actual DA levels (May $24->$46.7 ~= DA $44.8; Jan ->$46.1 ~= DA $43.8), which necessarily raises the annual mean. Per non-negotiable rule #1 a structurally-correct measured mechanism is KEPT even when an aggregate metric worsens, and the residual is NEVER tuned away — the overlay threshold is the competitive-vs-scarcity AS cutoff, not fit to this mean. The remaining over-level is the inherited energy-only-dual limitation (run154 was +17.6% on the same year; run157 nearly halves it). Open root cause for future work, no adder applied to close it.

C3b price duration/shape (soft). Monthly load-weighted NRMSE 0.206 vs the 0.20 band — DRAMATICALLY improved from run154's 0.430 by the measured DAM-AS overlay correctly forming the May/Jan acute-day scarcity the energy+reserve dual cannot. The small remaining gap is the residual energy-only-dual shape limitation (intra-month hourly scarcity not resolved by a monthly-mean overlay); structural, not fit to the residual.

C3b price duration/shape (soft; inherited, unchanged from run154). Monthly load-weighted NRMSE 0.317 vs the 0.20 band. The DAM-AS overlay is scoped off 2023 (its scarcity is carried by the RTORDPA overlay, not double-counted), so 2023 is byte-identical to the keeper. Energy-only-dual shape limitation shared with run151/run154; not fit to the residual.
